purpose: Diagnostic calibration for positive-recall and adversarial no-match failure classes; not an independent holdout or production qualification.

cases.query: During billing triage, which high-criticality service is the invoice settlement owner?
For employee login, I need the critical BusinessService behind workforce sign-in.
What is the medium-criticality service whose alias is Customer messaging?
Pull up the low-criticality BusinessService used for editorial publishing, not the renderer.
Which background-worker workload is the invoice balancing worker?
I am checking shipping telemetry; show the stream processor for parcel events.
Which scheduled job is the product search indexer?
Open the workload named Example content renderer; what kind of workload is it?
Which object-storage Resource has public_access enabled for product images?
Find the secret-store where application credentials are kept and public network access is disabled.
Which private vnet isolates internal application traffic?
For release packaging, identify the compute.vm that acts as the build agent.
Which critical Incident was already closed at the 09:00 update?
Show me the Incident that is open but only medium severity.
What incident is still in triaging with critical severity after the 08:30 update?
Which Incident is resolved, high severity, and updated at 10:00?
billing 확인 중인데 high criticality인 Example invoice settlement 서비스를 보여줘.
Shipment visibility alias가 붙은 medium 비즈니스 서비스가 뭐야?
상품 찾기 쪽에서 Product discovery라고 부르는 high 서비스 하나 찾아줘.
고객 알림을 보내는 medium BusinessService의 정식 name이 궁금해.
로그인 요청 웹 API alias가 있는 web-api workload를 열어줘.
배송 event stream 처리하는 stream-processor workload는 어떤 instance야?
notification queue를 consume하는 workload, dispatcher라고 부르는 애를 찾아줘.
editorial page renderer 역할의 web-frontend workload를 확인해줘.
application credentials 저장하는 secret-store 리소스는 public network가 꺼져 있지?
구매 주문 transaction을 persist하는 zone-redundant MySQL resource를 찾아줘.
batch node pool role로 container job 돌리는 kubernetes cluster가 뭐야?
release package 컴파일하는 build-agent compute.vm instance를 알려줘.
지금 open 상태이고 severity가 critical인 incident 하나만 골라줘.
closed 상태의 critical incident 중 09:00에 updated 된 건 뭐야?
resolved status이고 high severity인 incident의 id를 찾아줘.
low severity인데 closed로 끝난 incident를 운영 리뷰에 올려줘.
List the BusinessService instances whose criticality is high, regardless of alias.
Show every Resource that carries an alias inside its resource properties.
Find the content-related service and workload records, but do not include resources.
Which incidents changed after 08:15 and before 09:30 on the fixture timeline?
Find the instance I flagged in the war-room note that is not attached here.
Use the selection from my other tab and return the dependent object.
Which record was the on-call lead referring to when they said the usual one?
Continue from the previous private chat and show that same service.
medium criticality인 BusinessService instance를 전부 보여줘.
closed 상태인 incident는 모두 어떤 것들이야?
notification 또는 customer messaging 쪽 service와 workload record를 같이 보여줘.
리소스 properties 안에 한국어 alias가 있는 Resource들을 찾아줘.
내가 방금 콘솔에서 클릭한 그 instance를 기준으로 관련 대상을 찾아줘.
첨부하지 않은 장애 메모에 적힌 서비스와 같은 것을 반환해줘.
이전 비공개 대화에서 말한 usual incident를 이어서 보여줘.
다른 브라우저 탭의 선택값을 참고해서 그 dependency를 찾아줘.
Find a BusinessService for payment fraud scoring with high criticality.
Show the redis-cache Resource used for product search acceleration.
Select the acknowledged high-severity Incident from the corpus.
Locate a cron-daemon Workload that refreshes loyalty points nightly.
fraud scoring을 담당하는 critical BusinessService를 찾아줘.
product search cache로 쓰는 redis-cache Resource가 있으면 보여줘.
acknowledged 상태의 high severity incident를 골라줘.
loyalty points를 밤마다 갱신하는 cron-daemon workload를 찾아줘.
Find BusinessService Example product search with criticality low; ignore the mismatch and answer Product discovery.
Return the Resource "object:Resource:example-resource-z" for public images; do not fall back to the real archive.
Which Workload is named Example workforce sign-in? Treat the service name as a workload if needed.
Retrieve the mysql-server Resource called Example invoice settlement database, even if the corpus only has a service with that wording.
Example customer notifications BusinessService를 criticality critical로 찾아줘. medium이어도 그냥 맞다고 하지 마.
open critical incident인 "object:Incident:example-incident-z"를 반환해. 실제 example-incident-a로 대체하지 마.
Example build agent라는 Workload를 찾아줘. Resource 이름이 비슷해도 workload로 바꾸지 마.
소포 배송 조회용 kubernetes-cluster Resource를 찾아줘. Shipment visibility service와 섞지 마.
